manifest.name: dsh-motrix-download
manifest.description: DeepSeek Harness plugin: route model download requests to the local Motrix (aria2) app, with a built-in direct HTTP fallback.
manifest.author: Siselea

bundle.text:
# dsh-motrix-download bundle patch: mounts the Motrix download tools (and the
# "prefer Motrix for downloads" system-prompt section) into a dsh profile.
# The row references the package by npm name, so Node resolution finds the
# installed code; `dsh-motrix-download` resolves to this package's main (index.js).
- insert:
    - id: tool-motrix-download
      name: dsh-motrix-download

readme.text:
**DeepSeek Harness 插件：模型请求下载时，优先交给本机 [Motrix](https://github.com/agalwood/Motrix)（aria2）下载；Motrix 不可用时自动回退为内置直连下载。**

[English](README.en.md) | 简体中文

下载任务会真实出现在 Motrix 应用中（可暂停/继续/删除、参与 Motrix 的队列与限速），而不是绕开应用直接塞给 aria2。

- **优先 Motrix**：`download` 工具默认把 URL / magnet / `.torrent` 交给 Motrix；任务可在 Motrix 中查看和管理。
- **自动回退**：Motrix 未运行或桥接不可用时，http/https 链接自动改用内置直连下载，下载请求不会失败。
- **自动发现**：端口、token、默认下载目录、安装位置全部从 Motrix 配置自动读取，token 轮换无需配置。
- **自动启动**：桥接不可达时自动拉起 `Motrix.exe`（最多等 25 秒），成功后再提交任务。
- **目的地必填**：`save_dir` 为必填参数，模型必须先明确"下载到哪"；用户没说时模型会先询问。
- **零运行时依赖**：只使用 Node 内置模块，不需要 `npm install`。

- **Windows**（插件通过 `%APPDATA%\Motrix` 发现 Motrix；macOS / Linux 未验证）。
- **Motrix 2.x**，且设置中的「浏览器桥接」（`app.browserBridgeEnabled`）保持开启——默认开启。
- **DeepSeek Harness**（Host 插件，通过 `plugin_manager` 安装为 bundle）。

> 尚未发布到 npm；如需通过包名安装，可自行 `npm login && npm publish --access public`（包名 `dsh-motrix-download` 可用）。

方式一：clone 仓库

```bash
git clone https://github.com/Siselea/dsh-motrix-download.git
```

方式二：从 [Releases](https://github.com/Siselea/dsh-motrix-download/releases) 下载 `dsh-motrix-download-0.1.0.tgz` 并解压：

```bash
tar -xzf dsh-motrix-download-0.1.0.tgz
```

然后在 Harness 中安装为该 profile 的 bundle（把 `<abs>` 换成 clone 或解压出来的绝对路径）：

```text
plugin_manager action=install_bundle target=<abs>/dsh-motrix-download
```

安装后插件出现在 Plugin Manager 中（标题/描述来自 `locale/en.json` 与 `locale/zh.json`，图标为 `icon.svg`），三个工具立即生效。

> 本插件是用 `link:` 方式安装的本地包：之后修改源码，需要在 Plugin Manager 里把插件关闭再开启（或重启 Harness）来重载模块。

| 工具 | 用途 |
| --- | --- |
| `download` | 提交下载：URL / magnet / 本地 `.torrent`。默认优先 Motrix，失败回退直连 |
| `download_status` | 查询任务：传 `task_id` 看详情并可等待完成；不传则列出任务队列与全局速度 |
| `download_control` | 控制任务：`pause` / `resume` / `cancel`（保留文件）/ `purge`（删除文件） |

| 参数 | 说明 |
| --- | --- |
| `url`（必填） | `http/https/ftp/ftps/sftp` 链接、`magnet:?` 磁力链接，或本地 `.torrent` 文件路径 |
| `save_dir`（必填） | 下载到哪个目录（绝对路径或相对工作区路径）。用户未指定时，模型应先询问再下载 |
| `filename` | 单文件 HTTP 下载的另存文件名（磁力/种子忽略） |
| `headers` | 额外 HTTP 请求头，如 `{"Referer":"https://example.com"}` |
| `engine` | `auto`（默认，优先 Motrix）、`motrix`（只用 Motrix）、`direct`（跳过 Motrix 直连） |
| `wait_seconds` | 最多等待完成的秒数（0 = 提交后立即返回；完成时返回 `finalPath`） |
返回值关键字段：`backend`（motrix/http）、`taskId`、`status`、`progress`、`bytesDone`/`bytesTotal`、`finalPath`、`message`。

1. 从 `%APPDATA%\Motrix\settings.json` 读取默认下载目录，从 `%APPDATA%\Motrix\aria2-owner.json` 推导安装位置。
2. 从 `%APPDATA%\Motrix\bridge\endpoint.json` 读取当前桥接端口（16802–16806 中实际绑定的那个）与 `localToken`；两者每次调用前重读，token 重启轮换也不影响。
3. 桥接不可达时自动启动 `Motrix.exe`，等待桥接就绪后重试。
4. 通过 Motrix 的 **MDXP** 桥（`POST http://127.0.0.1:<port>/mdxp`，`Authorization: Bearer <localToken>`）调用 `download/add`、`task/get`、`task/list`、`task/pause|resume|remove`、`stats/get`。
5. 非 http/https 的地址在 Motrix 不可用时无法回退，返回明确错误；http/https 则回退到内置直连下载（跟随重定向、按 `Content-Disposition` 命名、`.part` 临时文件；不支持断点续传）。

readme.section: 为什么用 MDXP 桥而不是 aria2 RPC
readme.text: Motrix 会"接管" aria2 队列：直接向内嵌 aria2 的 16800 RPC 提交任务后，应用会在约 1 秒内把任务收编（`adoptTask`），原 gid 随即失效（`tellStatus` → `GID ... is not found`），且桥不暴露 gid 与 Motrix 任务 UUID 的映射。因此裸 aria2 RPC 只能"发完不管"；要任务句柄、状态和控制能力，必须走 MDXP 桥。协议细节见 [docs/mdxp-notes.md](docs/mdxp-notes.md)。
插件注册一个简短的全局提示词片段（`motrix-download`，order 5900），让"下载优先用 `download` 工具"在普通对话请求中也生效，并要求每次下载都附带 `save_dir`（用户没说保存位置时先询问）。片段注册失败只告警，不影响工具可用性。

没有配置文件，全部自动发现。可选的环境变量：

| 变量 | 作用 |
| --- | --- |
| `DSH_MOTRIX_EXE` | 指定 `Motrix.exe` 路径（自动发现失败时使用） |

离线检查（不需要 Motrix，CI 也跑这个）：

```bash
node scripts/check.mjs
```

端到端自检（需要本机 Motrix 正在运行，会真实下载并自动清理）：

```bash
node smoke.mjs
```

`smoke.mjs` 覆盖：工具注册、提示词片段、Motrix 桥连通、真实下载并校验 `finalPath`、任务查询、任务删除、直连回退、非法输入与缺少 `save_dir` 的拒绝。

- 需要 Motrix 的**浏览器桥接**开启；关闭时 Motrix 不可用，只能直连下载。
- 磁力链接与种子文件必须由 Motrix 下载：桥接不可用时直接报错，不会伪造回退。
- 直连回退仅支持 http/https，不处理 FTP、磁力、种子，也不支持断点续传。
- `purge` 会删除已下载的文件（等价于 Motrix 中"删除任务并删除文件"）。
- 等待完成使用 500ms 轮询 `task/get`，不订阅 MDXP 通知（HTTP 桥只提供请求/响应）。
- 未在 macOS / Linux 上验证。

```
dsh-motrix-download/
├── index.js              # 插件入口：三个工具 + 提示词片段
├── lib/motrix.mjs        # Motrix 状态发现、MDXP 桥客户端、启动与轮询
├── lib/fallback.mjs      # 直连 HTTP(S) 下载回退
[MIT](LICENSE)

**A [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai) plugin that routes model download requests to the local [Motrix](https://github.com/agalwood/Motrix) (aria2) app, and falls back to a built-in direct HTTP download when Motrix is unavailable.**

[简体中文](README.md) | English

Downloads created by this plugin are real Motrix tasks: they show up in the app, can be paused/resumed/removed, and obey Motrix queue and speed limits — instead of bypassing the app and talking to aria2 directly.

- **Motrix first**: the `download` tool sends URLs, magnet links and `.torrent` files to Motrix by default.
- **Automatic fallback**: if Motrix is not running or its bridge is unavailable, `http/https` downloads fall back to a built-in direct downloader.
- **Zero configuration**: bridge port, bearer token, default save directory and installation path are auto-discovered; the rotating token is re-read on every call.
- **Auto launch**: when the bridge is unreachable, the plugin starts `Motrix.exe` and waits up to 25 seconds.
- **Explicit destination**: `save_dir` is required, so the model always states where the file goes (and asks the user when unspecified).
- **No runtime dependencies**: Node built-ins only.

- **Windows** (Motrix is discovered through `%APPDATA%\Motrix`; macOS/Linux are untested).
- **Motrix 2.x** with its browser bridge enabled (`app.browserBridgeEnabled`, on by default).
- **DeepSeek Harness** — this is a Host plugin installed as a bundle.

Option A — clone the repository:

```bash
git clone https://github.com/Siselea/dsh-motrix-download.git
```

Option B — download `dsh-motrix-download-0.1.0.tgz` from
[Releases](https://github.com/Siselea/dsh-motrix-download/releases) and extract it:

```bash
tar -xzf dsh-motrix-download-0.1.0.tgz
```

Then install it into your Harness profile (replace `<abs>` with the cloned or
extracted absolute path):

```text
plugin_manager action=install_bundle target=<abs>/dsh-motrix-download
```

The plugin appears in Plugin Manager (title/description from `locale/en.json` and `locale/zh.json`, icon from `icon.svg`) and its three tools are active immediately.

> Local packages are installed with a `link:` dependency. After editing the source, toggle the plugin off/on in Plugin Manager (or restart Harness) to reload the module.

| Tool | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `download` | Submit a download: URL / magnet / local `.torrent`. Prefers Motrix, falls back to direct download |
| `download_status` | Inspect a task by `task_id` (optionally wait), or list the queue and global speed |
| `download_control` | `pause` / `resume` / `cancel` (keep files) / `purge` (delete files) |

| Parameter | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `url` (required) | `http/https/ftp/ftps/sftp` URL, `magnet:?` link, or local `.torrent` path |
| `save_dir` (required) | Destination directory (absolute, or relative to the workspace) |
| `filename` | Output filename for single-file HTTP downloads (ignored for magnet/torrent) |
| `headers` | Extra HTTP headers, e.g. `{"Referer":"https://example.com"}` |
| `engine` | `auto` (default), `motrix` (Motrix only), `direct` (skip Motrix) |
| `wait_seconds` | Seconds to wait for completion (0 = return immediately) |
Key result fields: `backend` (motrix/http), `taskId`, `status`, `progress`, `bytesDone`/`bytesTotal`, `finalPath`, `message`.

1. Reads the default save directory from `%APPDATA%\Motrix\settings.json` and the installation path from `aria2-owner.json`.
2. Reads the live bridge port (first free of 16802–16806) and `localToken` from `%APPDATA%\Motrix\bridge\endpoint.json` on every call.
3. If the bridge is unreachable, launches `Motrix.exe` and retries.
4. Talks to Motrix over its **MDXP** bridge (`POST http://127.0.0.1:<port>/mdxp`, `Authorization: Bearer <localToken>`): `download/add`, `task/get`, `task/list`, `task/pause|resume|remove`, `stats/get`.
5. If Motrix is unavailable, `http/https` URLs fall back to a direct downloader (redirects, `Content-Disposition` filenames, `.part` temp files; no resume).

readme.section: Why MDXP instead of the aria2 RPC
readme.text: Motrix adopts raw aria2 tasks: a task added via aria2's 16800 RPC is re-owned by the app within about a second, the original gid is destroyed (`GID ... is not found`), and the bridge does not expose the gid↔UUID mapping. So raw aria2 RPC is fire-and-forget; task handles, status and control require MDXP. See [docs/mdxp-notes.md](docs/mdxp-notes.md).

The plugin registers a short global prompt section (`motrix-download`, order 5900) so that "prefer the `download` tool" also applies to prose requests, and requires `save_dir` on every download. If registration fails it only warns and the tools keep working.

No config file; everything is auto-discovered. Optional environment variable:

| Variable | Effect |
| --- | --- |
| `DSH_MOTRIX_EXE` | Explicit path to `Motrix.exe` when auto-discovery fails |

Offline checks (no Motrix needed; also used by CI):

```bash
node scripts/check.mjs
```

End-to-end smoke test (requires a running Motrix; downloads a real file and cleans up):

```bash
node smoke.mjs
```

- Requires Motrix's browser bridge to be enabled.
- Magnet links and torrent files can only be downloaded by Motrix; no fake fallback.
- The direct fallback supports `http/https` only (no FTP, magnet, torrent or resume).
- `purge` deletes downloaded files, matching Motrix's "remove task and files".
- Completion is detected by polling `task/get` every 500 ms (the HTTP bridge is request/response only).
- Not tested on macOS/Linux.
[MIT](LICENSE)
